WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, e.ID,
           AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg,
           AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX, e.ID
), per_sex AS (
    SELECT SEX,
           AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS avg_acl_igg,
           AVG(avg_ana) AS avg_ana
    FROM per_patient
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT SEX, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana,
       avg_ana / AVG(avg_ana) OVER () AS ana_average_divided_by_mean_sex_ana
FROM per_sex;
